rows: trail / swing effect attached to the weapon or owner for the window

begin: pawn enables the collision group with the attack-data row; the Attack state handler 0x1413459E0 sets state+0x164 (first hit window opened: a cast may be requested from now on; an attack also needs TresEnableInput and a landed hit of this chain), clears state+0x1F4 bit 4 and state+0x234 bit 3, counts the hit window (slot 115: state+0x12C / +0x138). end 0x140564B10: group off (the hit list stays until the next activation)
window in which a weapon hit on world geometry recoils the attack (state REFLECT): sets primitive+0x987 bit 1 (0x140625C00 / 0x1406250E0); spec 8.2.5 step 9 and 8.5.1
blueprint event window (camera / state event component)
state+0x84 bit 2 (m_bEnableTraction) on / off: the homing window

state+0x84 bit 0 (m_bEnableChange): a queued next attack starts now; Attack state handler 0x141342DF0 also calls the controller (FUN_1414142D0(controller, 0): controller+0x878 bit 9 off); slot 128 ends the hover of an air-mode attack and Tick raises the cancel bit

state+0x84 bit 5: the next attack / launch request is accepted from here (if the first hit window has opened and a hit of this chain has landed, or with Combo Master); Tick also sets it at TresEnableChange
state+0x84 bit 4: the facing code snaps to the target on its next tick and re-reads the target metrics
stores the landing pose used by the Jump / Idle states (docs/sora-animation-spec.md)
stores the last pose kind (battle stance)
swing sound: m_SoundAliasID SWING1..6 of the weapon sound alias set (enumset_swing_w_so010)
Attack state handler 0x141344580: spawns the attack's projectile / shockwave (air down: DOWNIMPACT)
back raid: throws the keyblade (TresWeaponMovementComponent homing)
